faqs.q: How do I see the work in progress?
faqs.a: I send a preview link at every milestone. You can open it on your phone — no login needed.

faqs.q: What if I want to change something?
faqs.a: Small changes inside a milestone are free. Bigger changes go in a short change note with the extra cost and new date, so there are no surprises.
Payments follow the schedule on this page. Each payment is due on its date, and work on the next milestone starts once it arrives.
